name: sort
description: Sorts lines of text alphabetically, numerically, or by key.

flags.description: Unique: remove duplicate lines after sorting.
Sort by column N; -k2,2nr sorts column 2 numerically, reversed.

examples.explanation: Numeric order instead of lexicographic (where 10 would come before 2).
Finds the largest items: human sizes sorted with -h and reversed.
Sorts accounts by UID (3rd colon-separated field), numerically.

about: sort uses the locale for alphabetical ordering, which can surprise in scripts (e.g. ignoring punctuation). Set LC_ALL=C for strict byte-wise sorting — faster and predictable. -u both sorts and deduplicates, often replacing a separate uniq call.
useCases: Prepare data for uniq (which requires sorted input).
Rank logs by frequency with sort | uniq -c | sort -rn.
mistakes: Locale surprises in scripts; prefix with LC_ALL=C.
